units.zh: 列傳六十一
units.en: Biography 61
units.literal: Biographies 61

units.zh: 楊雍建姚締虞硃弘祚子綱王騭宋犖陳詵
units.en: Yang Yongjian, Yao Diyu, Zhu Hongzuo, Wang Zhi, Song Luo, and Chen Shen
units.literal: Yang Yongjian, Yao Diyu, Zhu Hongzuo, Wang Zhi, Song Luo, Chen Shen

units.zh: 楊雍建，字自西，浙江海寧人。
units.en: Yang Yongjian, whose courtesy name was Zixi, came from Haining in Zhejiang.
units.literal: Yang Yongjian, courtesy name Zixi, was a native of Haining in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 順治十二年進士，授廣東高耍知縣。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in the twelfth year of the Shunzhi reign and was posted as magistrate of Gaoyao in Guangdong.
units.literal: In the twelfth year of Shunzhi he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed magistrate of Gaoyao in Guangdong.

units.zh: 時方用兵，總督駐高耍。
units.en: The province was at war then, and the governor-general had his headquarters at Gaoyao.
units.literal: At the time the army was on campaign, and the governor-general was stationed at Gaoyao.

units.zh: 師行徵民夫，吏慮其逃，縶之官廨。
units.en: Whenever the troops moved they drafted civilian laborers, and the clerks, afraid the men would run away, kept them shackled in the magistrate's compound.
units.literal: When the army marched it conscripted laborers; clerks, fearing they would flee, bound them in the yamen.

units.zh: 當除夕，雍建命徙廊廡，撤餚饌畀之。
units.en: On New Year's Eve he had them moved into the side halls and sent out his own holiday dishes for them to eat.
units.literal: On New Year's Eve Yongjian ordered them moved to the corridors and had the feast dishes taken out and given to them.

units.zh: 師中索榕樹枝製繩以燃砲，軍吏檄徵，語不遜，雍建笞之。
units.en: The army wanted banyan branches to twist into fuses for the guns; a military clerk sent a requisition couched in insulting language, and Yongjian had him beaten.
units.literal: The army demanded banyan branches to make ropes for firing cannon; a military clerk requisitioned them by dispatch with insolent words, and Yongjian had him flogged.

units.zh: 總督王國光以是稱雍建方剛，特疏薦。
units.en: Governor-General Wang Guoguang cited these acts to praise Yongjian's firm integrity and submitted a special recommendation on his behalf.
units.literal: Governor-General Wang Guoguang on this account praised Yongjian as upright and firm, and memorialized especially to recommend him.

units.zh: 蒞官甫一年，擢兵科給事中。
units.en: After only a year in post he was promoted to supervising secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for War.
units.literal: He had held office barely a year when he was promoted to supervising secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for War.

units.zh: 十六年春，世祖幸南苑，雍建疏言：「昨因聖體違和，傳諭孟春饗太廟，遣官致祭。
units.en: In the spring of the sixteenth year the Shunzhi Emperor went to the Southern Park, and Yongjian submitted a memorial: 'Recently, because Your Majesty was unwell, the court announced that the spring sacrifice at the Grand Temple would be performed by dispatched officials.
units.literal: In the spring of the sixteenth year the Shizu Emperor visited the Southern Park; Yongjian memorialized, saying: 'Yesterday, because the Sacred Person was unwell, an edict was issued that at the first month of spring the Grand Temple would be feasted and officials dispatched to perform the sacrifice.

units.zh: 至期皇躬康豫，仍親廟祀，此敬修祀典之盛心也。
units.en: When the day arrived Your Majesty had recovered and still went in person to the temple—a splendid devotion to the rites of worship.
units.literal: When the day came the imperial person was restored to health and still personally worshipped at the temple—this is the great mind that reverently maintains the sacrificial statutes.

units.zh: 乃回宮未幾，复幸南苑，寒威未釋，陟歷郊原，恐不足以慎起居。
units.en: Yet scarcely had you returned to the palace when you went again to the Southern Park; the cold has not lifted, and to range the open countryside may not be prudent for Your Majesty's health and regimen.
units.literal: Yet not long after returning to the palace, again visiting the Southern Park—cold majesty not yet released, climbing and traversing the suburban wilds—I fear this is not enough to be careful of daily living.

units.zh: 且古者蒐苗狝狩，各有其時。
units.en: Besides, in antiquity the spring, summer, autumn, and winter hunts each had its proper season.
units.literal: Moreover, in antiquity the sou, miao, xian, and shou hunts each had their season.

units.zh: 設使獸起於前，馬逸於後，驚屬車之清塵，豈能無萬一之慮？」
units.en: If a beast should start up ahead or a horse run away behind and startle the imperial train, could there be no risk at all?'
units.literal: Suppose a beast sprang up ahead or a horse bolted behind and startled the clear dust of the attendant chariots—how could there be no thought of the slightest mishap?'

units.zh: 疏入，上甚怒，宣雍建入，諭以閱兵習武之意。
units.en: When the memorial arrived the emperor was furious and had Yongjian brought in to explain that the visit was for inspecting troops and military drill.
units.literal: When the memorial entered, the emperor was greatly angry, summoned Yongjian in, and instructed him of the intent to review troops and practice martial arts.

units.zh: 雍建奏對不失常度，上意亦解。
units.en: Yongjian answered calmly and without losing his bearing, and the emperor's anger subsided.
units.literal: Yongjian replied in audience without losing his usual composure, and the emperor's mind was also eased.

units.zh: 時平南王尚可喜、靖南王耿繼茂並鎮廣東，雍建疏陳廣東害民之政八：委吏太濫，雜派太繁，裡役無定例，用夫無定制，鹽埠日橫，私稅日盈，伐薪採木，大肆流毒，均宜亟為革除。
units.en: At that time the Prince of Pingnan, Shang Kexi, and the Prince of Jingnan, Geng Jimao, both held Guangdong. Yongjian listed eight abuses there: too many petty agents, too many surcharges, village labor service without fixed rules, corvée without fixed quotas, salt franchises growing more oppressive by the day, illicit levies swelling daily, and rampant logging and fuel-cutting—all of which should be abolished at once.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Pingnan Shang Kexi and the Prince of Jingnan Geng Jimao both garrisoned Guangdong; Yongjian memorialized eight policies in Guangdong that harmed the people: delegated clerks too numerous, miscellaneous levies too many, village corvée without fixed rules, labor requisition without fixed regulations, salt monopolies growing daily overbearing, private taxes daily increasing, cutting firewood and gathering timber spreading great harm—all should urgently be abolished.

units.zh: 且兩籓並建，供億維繁。
units.en: With two princely establishments in the same province, the burden of provisioning them was crushing.
units.literal: Moreover, with two feudatories established together, supply and support were exceedingly burdensome.

units.zh: 今川、貴底定，請移一籓鎮撫其地，俾粵民甦息。
units.en: Now that Sichuan and Guizhou were pacified, he asked that one of the princes be transferred to garrison there so the people of Guangdong could breathe again.
units.literal: Now that Sichuan and Guizhou are settled, he asked to move one feudatory to pacify and oversee that region, so that the people of Guangdong might revive and rest.

units.zh: 上尋命繼茂移鎮福建，雍建發之也。
units.en: The court soon ordered Geng Jimao to move his headquarters to Fujian, a change Yongjian had initiated.
units.literal: The emperor soon ordered Jizhuo to transfer his garrison to Fujian—it was Yongjian who set this in motion.

units.zh: 十七年，疏言：「朋黨之患，釀於草野。
units.en: In the seventeenth year he wrote: 'The evil of cliques begins among the common people.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year he memorialized: 'The affliction of factional cliques is brewed in the countryside.

units.zh: 欲塞其源，宜嚴禁盟社，請飭學臣查禁。」
units.en: To stop it at the source, sworn brotherhoods and societies should be strictly banned, and he asked that provincial education commissioners be ordered to search them out and suppress them.'
units.literal: To block its source, alliance societies should be strictly forbidden; he asked that educational officials be ordered to investigate and ban them.'

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The emperor approved.
units.literal: The court assented.

units.zh: 轉吏科給事中。
units.en: He was transferred to supervising secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel.
units.literal: He was transferred to supervising secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel.

units.zh: 聖祖即位，輔臣秉政，奏事者入見，皆長跪，雍建獨立語。
units.en: When the Kangxi Emperor ascended the throne, the regents held power; everyone who came to report knelt, but Yongjian alone remained standing when he spoke.
units.literal: When the Shengzu Emperor took the throne, assisting ministers held power; those who came in audience to report all knelt long, but Yongjian alone stood and spoke.

units.zh: 比退，輔臣目之曰：「此南苑上書諫獵者也。」
units.en: As he left, a regent fixed him with a stare and said, 'So this is the man who lectured the emperor about hunting at the Southern Park.'
units.literal: When he withdrew, an assisting minister eyed him and said: 'This is the one who at the Southern Park submitted a memorial admonishing the hunt.'

units.zh: 自是奏事者見輔臣皆不跪。
units.en: After that, officials reporting to the regents no longer knelt.
units.literal: From then on those who reported affairs did not kneel when they saw assisting ministers.

units.zh: 康熙三年，彗星見。
units.en: In the third year of the Kangxi reign a comet appeared.
units.literal: In the third year of Kangxi a comet appeared.

units.zh: 雍建奏言：「天心仁愛，垂象示警。
units.en: Yongjian wrote: 'Heaven is merciful; it sends portents as a warning.
units.literal: Yongjian memorialized: 'Heaven's mind is benevolent; it sends down signs to warn.

units.zh: 乞齋心修省，廣求直言，詳詢利病，並飭內外臣工，滌慮洗心，共修職業，」上優旨褒答。
units.en: He urged the emperor to fast, reflect, and reform; to welcome frank counsel; to investigate what helped or harmed the realm; and to order officials everywhere to clear their minds and do their duty.' The emperor replied with a warm commendation.'
units.literal: He begged to purify the mind and cultivate self-examination, broadly seek forthright speech, inquire in detail into benefits and harms, and also order inner and outer officials to cleanse thoughts and hearts and together cultivate their duties.' The emperor answered with gracious edict and praise.'

units.zh: 四年，疏言：「治化未醇，由於臣職未盡。
units.en: In the fourth year he wrote: 'Good government has not yet matured because officials are not doing their jobs.
units.literal: In the fourth year he memorialized: 'Governance and transformation are not yet pure because ministers' duties are not fulfilled.

units.zh: 比者部臣以推諉為卸責，明為本部應議之事，或請諮別部，或請飭督撫，致一案之處分，因一人之口供未到而更待另議；
units.en: Lately ministry officials treat evasion as discharge of duty: matters plainly within their own jurisdiction they refer to other ministries or to the governors, so that a case cannot be decided because one witness statement is missing and must be reopened;
units.literal: Recently ministry officials take shirking as unloading responsibility: matters clearly belonging to their ministry to deliberate they either ask to consult another ministry or ask to order governors-general and governors, so that disposition of a case, because one person's testimony has not arrived, must again await separate deliberation;

units.zh: 一事之行止，因一時文卷小誤而重俟行查；
units.en: whether a matter goes forward or stalls because of a minor clerical error in the paperwork, they order yet another review;
units.literal: whether a matter proceeds or stops, because of a momentary small error in documents, again awaits investigation;

units.zh: 至地方利弊所關，憚於釐正，輒云已經題定，無庸再議。
units.en: and on local abuses that touch the public welfare they are afraid to act, saying only that the matter was already reported and settled and need not be discussed again.
units.literal: as for local benefits and harms involved, fearing to rectify they always say it has already been memorialized and settled and need not be discussed again.

units.zh: 如此，則一二胥吏執定例以駁之足矣，不知滿、漢堂司各官所司為何事也。
units.en: At that rate a couple of clerks with the regulations could settle everything, and one might wonder what the Manchu and Han directors in the ministries are for.
units.literal: If so, then one or two clerks holding to fixed precedents to rebut them would suffice—one does not know what the Manchu and Han directors and section chiefs in the ministries are charged with.

units.zh: 督撫以蒙蔽為苟安，民苦於差徭，而額外之私徵，未聞建長策以除積困；
units.en: Governors-general and governors treat cover-ups as peace; the people groan under labor service and levies, while illicit surcharges go on, yet no one proposes a real plan to end chronic abuses;
units.literal: Governors-general and governors take concealment as temporary peace; the people suffer from corvée and levies, yet extra private exactions—no long-term policy is heard proposed to remove accumulated distress;

units.zh: 吏橫於貪暴，而有司之掊克，不過摘薄罪以引輕條。
units.en: petty officials run wild in greed and cruelty, yet when their superiors punish extortion they cite only minor charges under the mildest articles of law.
units.literal: clerks are overbearing in greed and violence, yet when superiors punish extortion they only pick out petty offenses to invoke light statutes.

units.zh: 向日行考滿之法，則題報者皆稱職，曾無三等以下之劣員；
units.en: Under the triennial evaluation everyone reported was rated competent, and no one ever received a grade below the third rank;
units.literal: when the former triennial evaluation was carried out, those memorialized were all competent, never a poor officer below the third grade;

units.zh: 平時上彈劾之章，則特糾者僅末僚，不及道府以上之大吏。
units.en: and in routine impeachments only junior officials were singled out, never the great officers at the circuit or prefectural level and above.
units.literal: in ordinary times memorials of impeachment specially denounced only low subordinates, not reaching great officials at the circuit and prefectural level and above.

units.zh: 凡此推諉蒙蔽之習，請嚴飭內外臣工各圖報稱，儻仍蹈故轍，立予罷斥，以儆官常。」
units.en: For all these habits of evasion and cover-up he asked that officials everywhere be strictly ordered to do their duty; if they persisted in the old ways they should be dismissed at once as a warning to the service.'
units.literal: All these habits of shirking and concealment—he asked that inner and outer officials be strictly ordered each to plan to repay their charge; if they still tread the old rut, immediately dismiss them, to warn official norms.'

units.zh: 疏入，報聞。
units.en: The memorial was received and noted.
units.literal: When the memorial entered, acknowledgment was returned.

units.zh: 尋自刑科都給事中累擢左副都御史。
units.en: He was soon promoted from chief supervising secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Justice to left vice censor-in-chief.
units.literal: Soon from chief supervising secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Justice he was repeatedly promoted to left vice censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 十八年，典會試，授貴州巡撫。
units.en: In the eighteenth year he served as chief examiner for the metropolitan civil service examination and was appointed governor of Guizhou.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year he presided over the metropolitan examination and was appointed governor of Guizhou.

units.zh: 疏請立營製，減徭役，招集流亡，禁革私派。
units.en: He asked permission to set up garrison regulations, cut corvée and levies, bring back refugees, and ban illicit local exactions.
units.literal: He memorialized asking to establish camp regulations, reduce corvée and levies, gather scattered refugees, and forbid and abolish private surcharges.

units.zh: 土司謁巡撫，故事，必鳴鼓角，交戟於門，俾拜其下。
units.en: When native chieftains came to call on the governor, custom required drums and horns and crossed halberds at the gate, forcing them to prostrate themselves outside.
units.literal: When native chieftains called on the governor, by precedent drums and horns had to sound and halberds cross at the gate, making them bow below.

units.zh: 雍建悉屏去，引至座前問疾苦，予以酒食，土司咸輸服。
units.en: Yongjian abolished all of that, had them brought before his desk to hear their grievances, and gave them food and wine; the chieftains were all won over.
units.literal: Yongjian removed all of these, led them before his seat to ask their hardships, and gave them wine and food; the native chieftains all submitted in conviction.

units.zh: 始，貴陽斗米值錢五千，雍建請轉餉以給。
units.en: At first a bushel of rice in Guiyang cost five thousand cash; Yongjian arranged to bring in grain from elsewhere to feed the people.
units.literal: At first a dou of rice in Guiyang cost five thousand cash; Yongjian asked to transfer grain pay to supply it.

units.zh: 既，令民翦荒茅，教以耕種。
units.en: Then he had the people clear the wild growth and taught them how to farm.
units.literal: Thereafter he ordered the people to cut wild thatch and taught them to cultivate.

units.zh: 比三年，稻田日闢，民食以裕。
units.en: Within three years more and more paddy was under cultivation and the people had enough to eat.
units.literal: By the third year paddy fields were daily opened and the people's food thereby became ample.

units.zh: 二十三年，召授兵部侍郎。
units.en: In the twenty-third year he was recalled to the capital and appointed vice minister of War.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year he was summoned and appointed vice minister of War.

units.zh: 尋以親老乞終養，許之。
units.en: Soon afterward he asked to retire and care for his aging parents, and the request was granted.
units.literal: Soon, because his parents were aged, he begged to retire and care for them to the end; this was granted.

units.zh: 四十三年，卒，賜祭葬。
units.en: He died in the forty-third year of Kangxi, and the court granted him the rites of state burial.
units.literal: In the forty-third year he died; sacrificial burial was bestowed.

units.zh: 子中訥，進士，官右中允。
units.en: His son Zhongne, a jinshi, served as right assistant expositor in the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: His son Zhongne was a jinshi and served as right assistant expositor.

units.zh: 姚締虞，字歷升，湖廣黃陂人。
units.en: Yao Diyu, whose courtesy name was Lisheng, came from Huangpi in Huguang.
units.literal: Yao Diyu, courtesy name Lisheng, was a native of Huangpi in Huguang.

units.zh: 順治十五年進士，授四川成都府推官。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in the fifteenth year of Shunzhi and was posted as prefectural judge of Chengdu Prefecture in Sichuan.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year of Shunzhi he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed prefectural judge of Chengdu Prefecture in Sichuan.

units.zh: 四川殘民多聚為盜，互告訐，釀大獄。
units.en: In war-ravaged Sichuan many survivors had turned to banditry; they denounced one another in court, and major prosecutions followed.
units.literal: In Sichuan many remnant people gathered as bandits, mutually informing and accusing, brewing great cases.

units.zh: 締虞平恕讞鞫，輒得其情，審釋叛案株連獄囚十七人。
units.en: Diyu judged cases with calm fairness and usually got to the truth; he reviewed a treason case and freed seventeen people who had been caught in the net of implication.
units.literal: Diyu was even-tempered and lenient in judging and examining cases, always getting the facts; he reviewed and released seventeen prisoners implicated in a treason case.

units.zh: 總督苗澄、巡撫張德地薦廉能，舉卓異，會裁缺，改陝西安化知縣。
units.en: Governor-General Miao Cheng and Governor Zhang Dedi praised his integrity and ability and marked him as outstanding; when posts were reduced he was reassigned as magistrate of Anhua in Shaanxi.
units.literal: Governor-General Miao Cheng and Governor Zhang Dedi recommended him as incorrupt and capable and nominated him as outstanding; when posts were cut he was transferred to magistrate of Anhua in Shaanxi.

units.zh: 行取，康熙十五年，授禮科給事中。
units.en: Selected for service in the capital, he was appointed in the fifteenth year of Kangxi as supervising secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Rites.
units.literal: Selected for capital office, in the fifteenth year of Kangxi he was appointed supervising secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Rites.

units.zh: 疏請嚴選庶吉士，考覈翰林，報聞。
units.en: He asked that Hanlin bachelors be chosen more rigorously and that the Academy be audited; the memorial was noted.
units.literal: He memorialized asking to strictly select Hanlin bachelors and examine the Hanlin Academy; acknowledgment was returned.

units.zh: 十七年，典試江西，還，奏：「江西被賊殘破州縣在丁缺田荒案內者，請敕督撫酌量輕重，限三年或五年勸墾，以漸昇科。
units.en: In the seventeenth year he served as chief examiner in Jiangxi; on his return he reported: 'For counties in Jiangxi ruined by rebels and listed as having missing registers and abandoned fields, the governors should be ordered to weigh each case and allow three or five years to bring land back under cultivation before taxes are restored.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year he served as chief examiner in Jiangxi; on return he memorialized: 'Jiangxi prefectures and counties ravaged by bandits that fall within cases of missing population registers and abandoned fields—he asked that governors-general and governors be ordered to weigh severity, set a limit of three or five years to encourage cultivation, and gradually restore taxation.

units.zh: 全省逋賦二百二十萬，歷年追比，僅報完三萬。
units.en: The province owed 2.2 million taels in back taxes; after years of relentless collection only 30,000 had been reported paid.
units.literal: The whole province's arrears in land tax amounted to 2.2 million; pursued year after year, only 30,000 was reported collected.

units.zh: 此二百十餘萬，雖敲骨吸髓，勢必不能復完。
units.en: The remaining 2.1 million could never be collected even if the people were squeezed to the bone.
units.literal: This more than 2.1 million—even if one knocked bones and sucked marrow—could in no case be fully recovered.

units.zh: 請早予蠲免，俾小民得免死亡。」
units.en: He asked that it be remitted soon so the common people would not die under the burden.'
units.literal: He asked that remission be granted early, so that the common people might escape death.'

units.zh: 十八年，地震，求言。
units.en: In the eighteenth year an earthquake struck, and the court called for memorials.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year there was an earthquake; the court sought memorials.

units.zh: 締虞上疏曰：「科道乃朝廷耳目之官，原期知無不言，有聞則告。
units.en: Diyu wrote: 'The censors and supervising secretaries are the eyes and ears of the court; they are meant to speak of whatever they know and report whatever they hear.
units.literal: Diyu submitted a memorial saying: 'The censorate and supervising secretaries are the court's eyes and ears; originally it was expected that knowing something they would not fail to speak, hearing something they would report.

units.zh: 自故憲臣艾元徵請禁風聞條奏，自此言路氣靡，中外多所顧忌。
units.en: Ever since the late censor Ai Yuanzheng asked to ban memorials based on rumor, the voice of remonstrance has withered and officials everywhere have grown cautious.
units.literal: Since the late censor Ai Yuanzheng asked to forbid memorials on hearsay, from then the avenue of speech wilted in spirit and inner and outer circles were much restrained.

units.zh: 臣請皇上省覽世祖朝諸臣奏議，如何謇諤；
units.en: I beg Your Majesty to read the memorials of the Shunzhi reign and see how blunt they were;
units.literal: Your servant asks Your Majesty to review the memorials and deliberations of officials in the Shizu reign—how outspoken they were;

units.zh: 今者相率以條陳為事，輭熟成風。
units.en: today everyone files the same bland itemized reports, and timid conformity has become the norm.
units.literal: now all follow one another in making routine itemized submissions, and a soft, smooth manner has become the fashion.

units.zh: 蓋平時無以作其敢言之氣，一旦欲其慷慨直陳，難矣。
units.en: If nothing in peacetime stirs their courage to speak out, it is hard to expect bold truth-telling when it is needed.
units.literal: For in ordinary times nothing rouses their spirit of daring to speak; once wanting them to speak forthrightly and directly is difficult.

units.zh: 乞敕廷臣會議，嗣後有矢志忠誠、指斥奸佞者，即少差謬，亦賜矜全。
units.en: He asked the court to deliberate: hereafter, if a man is loyal at heart and denounces the corrupt, even when he is slightly wrong, let him be spared.
units.literal: He begged that court ministers be ordered to confer: hereafter if one is steadfast in loyalty and denounces the wicked, even if slightly mistaken, also grant lenient preservation.

units.zh: 如或快意恩仇，受人指使，章奏鈔傳，眾目難掩，縱令彈劾得實，亦難免於徇私之罪。
units.en: But if a man pursues private vendettas, takes orders from others, and his memorials circulate in copies for all to see, then even a true accusation will still be punished as self-serving.
units.literal: If one indulges private enmity, is directed by others, and memorials are copied and spread—many eyes cannot hide it—even if impeachment is substantiated, it is still hard to escape the crime of partiality.

units.zh: 如此，則言官有所顧忌，不敢妄言；
units.en: In that way censors would have reason to be careful and would not speak recklessly;
units.literal: In this way censorial officials would have something to fear and not dare speak rashly;

units.zh: 中外諸臣有所顧忌，不敢妄為。」
units.en: and officials everywhere would think twice before acting recklessly.'
units.literal: inner and outer officials would have something to fear and not dare act rashly.'

units.zh: 疏下九卿科道會議。
units.en: The memorial was referred to the Nine Ministers and the censorate for joint deliberation.
units.literal: The memorial was sent down to the Nine Ministers and the censorate for joint deliberation.

units.zh: 越日，召廷臣等集中左門，上問：「締虞疏如何定議？」
units.en: The next day the ministers were summoned to the Left Gate, and the emperor asked, 'What is your decision on Diyu's memorial?'
units.literal: The next day the court ministers were summoned to assemble at the Left Gate; the emperor asked: 'How is Diyu's memorial to be decided?'

units.zh: 吏部尚書郝惟訥等暨給事中李宗孔等俱言風聞之例，不宜復開。
units.en: Minister of Personnel Hao Weine, supervising secretary Li Zongkong, and the others all said the ban on hearsay memorials should not be lifted.
units.literal: Minister of Personnel Hao Weine and others together with supervising secretary Li Zongkong and others all said the precedent on hearsay should not be reopened.

units.zh: 上問：「締虞，爾意如何？」
units.en: The emperor turned to him: 'Diyu, what do you think?'
units.literal: The emperor asked: 'Diyu, what is your view?'

units.zh: 締虞對曰：「皇上明聖，從未譴罪言官。
units.en: Diyu answered: 'Your Majesty is wise and has never punished a censor.
units.literal: Diyu replied: 'Your Majesty is enlightened and sage and has never punished censorial officials.

units.zh: 但有處分條例在，言官皆生畏懼。」
units.en: But as long as the disciplinary statutes remain on the books, every censor is afraid.'
units.literal: But because disciplinary regulations exist, censorial officials all grow fearful.'

units.zh: 上曰：「如汝言，條例便當廢耶？」
units.en: The emperor said, 'So by your logic the regulations should be scrapped?'
units.literal: The emperor said: 'As you say, should the regulations then be abolished?'

units.zh: 締虞對曰：「科條雖設，當辨公私誠偽。」
units.en: Diyu replied, 'The statutes may stay, but each case should be judged on whether the motive was public or private, sincere or false.'
units.literal: Diyu replied: 'Though the statutes are set up, public and private, sincerity and falsity should be distinguished.'

units.zh: 上意稍解。
units.en: The emperor's mood softened.
units.literal: The emperor's mind was somewhat eased.

units.zh: 諭言：「官宜敷陳國家大事，如有大奸大貪，糾劾得實，法在必行，決不姑貸。
units.en: He instructed them: 'Officials should speak frankly on matters of state. When great traitors or great thieves are impeached and the charge is proved, the law will be enforced without mercy.
units.literal: An edict stated: 'Officials should set forth great affairs of state; if there are great traitors or great corruption and impeachment is substantiated, the law must be enforced and will in no case be indulgently spared.

units.zh: 且魏象樞彈奏程汝璞，亦是風聞，已鞫問得實，原未嘗有風聞之禁也。」
units.en: When Wei Xiangshu impeached Cheng Rupu it was also on hearsay, yet the charge was proved in court—there has never really been a ban on hearsay memorials.'
units.literal: Moreover, when Wei Xiangshu impeached Cheng Rupu it was also on hearsay; inquiry already established the facts—originally there was never a ban on hearsay.'

units.zh: 上宣締虞前，指內閣所呈世祖時章奏示之曰：「汝以朕為未閱此乎？」
units.en: He had Diyu step forward, pointed to Shunzhi-era memorials the Grand Secretariat had submitted, and said, 'Do you think I have not read these?'
units.literal: The emperor had Diyu come forward, pointed to memorials from the Shizu reign presented by the Grand Secretariat, and showed them, saying: 'Do you think I have not read these?'

units.zh: 締虞對曰：「惟久經聖覽，臣故不憚盡言。」
units.en: Diyu answered, 'Precisely because Your Majesty has read them, I did not hesitate to speak my mind.'
units.literal: Diyu replied: 'Because they have long received the Sacred View, your servant therefore does not fear to speak fully.'

units.zh: 上命以所言宣付史館。
units.en: The emperor ordered his words recorded and sent to the Historiography Institute.
units.literal: The emperor ordered that what was said be proclaimed and sent to the Historiography Institute.

units.zh: 次日，復命締虞入起居注，授筆札記之。
units.en: The next day he had Diyu enter the office of the Veritable Records and write the account himself.
units.literal: The next day he again ordered Diyu to enter the Veritable Records office and gave him brush and paper to record it.

units.zh: 尋轉工科掌印給事中。
units.en: He was soon made chief supervising secretary with seal in the Office of Scrutiny for Works.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to chief supervising secretary with seal in the Office of Scrutiny for Works.

units.zh: 上考察科道，黜孫緒極、傅廷俊、和鹽鼎三人，而嘉締虞與王曰溫、李迥稱職。
units.en: When the emperor reviewed the censorate he dismissed Sun Xuji, Fu Tingjun, and He Yanding, but praised Diyu, Wang Yuewen, and Li Jiong as fit for their posts.
units.literal: The emperor inspected the censorate; Sun Xuji, Fu Tingjun, and He Yanding were dismissed, while Diyu together with Wang Yuewen and Li Jiong were praised as competent in office.

units.zh: 二十一年，疏論外吏積習，視事偷惰，公務沉閣，文移遲緩；
units.en: In the twenty-first year he wrote on the chronic habits of provincial officials: neglecting their duties, letting business pile up, and delaying paperwork;
units.literal: In the twenty-first year he memorialized on the accumulated habits of outer officials: attending to duties with lazy theft, public business sunk in files, documents and transfers delayed;

units.zh: 僚屬宴會，遊客酬酢，廢時糜費。
units.en: feasting with subordinates, entertaining visitors, and wasting time and money.
units.literal: subordinates feasting, travelers exchanging toasts, wasting time and squandering expense.

units.zh: 請敕部禁飭。
units.en: He asked the ministries to forbid such conduct.
units.literal: He asked that the ministries be ordered to forbid and correct this.

units.zh: 累擢左僉都御史。
units.en: He rose to left assistant censor-in-chief.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to left assistant censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 二十四年，授四川巡撫。
units.en: In the twenty-fourth year he was appointed governor of Sichuan.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was appointed governor of Sichuan.

units.zh: 締虞先為推官有聲，百姓喜其來。
units.en: Diyu had won a good name years before as prefectural judge, and the people were glad to see him return.
units.literal: Diyu had earlier been famous as prefectural judge, and the common people rejoiced at his coming.

units.zh: 締虞至，榜上諭於廳事，嚴約束，禁私徵雜派，杜絕餽遺，屬吏憚之。
units.en: When he arrived he posted notices in the yamen hall with strict rules, banned illicit levies and surcharges, refused all gifts, and his subordinates were afraid to cross him.
units.literal: When Diyu arrived he posted proclamations in the hall of audience with strict restraints, forbidding private levies and miscellaneous surcharges, cutting off gifts entirely, and subordinate officials feared him.

units.zh: 疏言：「四川迭經兵火，荒殘已極。
units.en: He wrote: 'Sichuan has been ravaged by war after war and is utterly devastated.
units.literal: He memorialized: 'Sichuan has suffered repeated warfare; desolation is extreme.

units.zh: 官戶鄉紳，多流寓外省，雖令子弟復業，迨入學鄉舉登仕版後，仍棄本籍他往。
units.en: Gentry and official families mostly live abroad; even when sons are sent home to farm, once they pass exams and take office they leave again.
units.literal: Official households and local gentry mostly sojourn in other provinces; though their sons and younger kin are ordered to resume their estates, once they enter school, take the provincial examination, and join the rolls of office they still abandon their native place and go elsewhere.

units.zh: 百姓見其如此，亦裹足不歸。
units.en: Seeing this, ordinary people too hesitate to come home.
units.literal: The common people, seeing them act thus, also hold back their feet and do not return.

units.zh: 若招回鄉宦一家，可抵百姓數戶。
units.en: Bringing back one eminent family can do as much as several common households.
units.literal: If one gentry family is summoned back, it can equal several common households.

units.zh: 紳宦既歸，百姓亦不招而自至。
units.en: Once the gentry return, the people follow without needing to be called.
units.literal: Once the gentry return, the common people also arrive without being summoned.

units.zh: 今察明各屬流寓外省紳衿，請敕部移行，飭令復業。」
units.en: He identified gentry living out of province and asked the ministries to order them home to rebuild their estates.'
units.literal: Now, having investigated gentry and scholars sojourning in other provinces under each jurisdiction, he asked that the ministries be ordered to send notices and command them to resume their estates.'

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The emperor approved.
units.literal: The court assented.

units.zh: 蜀人困於採木，締虞陛辭，首陳其害。
units.en: The people of Sichuan were crushed by the timber levy; at his farewell audience Diyu spoke first of the harm.
units.literal: The people of Shu were distressed by timber-cutting; at his farewell audience Diyu first set forth its harm.

units.zh: 會鬆威道王騭入覲，亦舉是以奏，詔特免之。
units.en: When Wang Zhi of the Songwei circuit came to court he made the same plea, and the emperor granted a special exemption.
units.literal: When Wang Zhi of the Songwei circuit came to audience he also memorialized on this; an edict specially exempted it.

units.zh: 復請免運白蠟，停解鐵稅，皆獲施行。
units.en: He also secured exemption of white-wax transport and suspension of the iron tax.
units.literal: He again asked to exempt transport of white wax and halt delivery of iron tax; all were put into effect.

units.zh: 二十七年，卒官，賜祭葬。
units.en: He died in office in the twenty-seventh year and was granted state burial rites.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he died in office; sacrificial burial was bestowed.

units.zh: 硃弘祚，字徽廕，山東高唐人，昌祚弟。
units.en: Zhu Hongzuo, whose courtesy name was Huiyin, came from Gaotang in Shandong and was the younger brother of Changzuo.
units.literal: Zhu Hongzuo, courtesy name Huiyin, was a native of Gaotang in Shandong and younger brother of Changzuo.

units.zh: 弘祚自舉人授江南盱眙知縣，有惠政，舉卓異。
units.en: Starting as a provincial graduate, he became magistrate of Xuyi in Jiangnan, governed well, and was marked outstanding.
units.literal: Hongzuo, from juren, was appointed magistrate of Xuyi in Jiangnan; he had benevolent policies and was nominated as outstanding.

units.zh: 康熙十四年，行取御史，以昌祚子紱官大理寺卿迴避，改刑部主事。
units.en: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi he was selected for the capital as a censor, but because Changzuo's son Fu was chief minister of the Court of Judicial Review he recused himself and became a principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi, selected for the capital, he was to be made a censor; because Changzuo's son Fu held office as chief minister of the Court of Judicial Review, he recused himself and was changed to a principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice.

units.zh: 再遷兵部督捕郎中，出為直隸天津道僉事，調直隸守道參議。
units.en: He rose to director in the Ministry of War for bandit suppression, then served as administration commissioner of the Tianjin circuit in Zhili and then of the Zhili defense circuit.
units.literal: He was again promoted to director in the Ministry of War in charge of bandit suppression, then went out as administration commissioner of the Tianjin circuit in Zhili, and was transferred to administration commissioner of the Zhili defense circuit.

units.zh: 二十六年，超擢廣東巡撫。
units.en: In the twenty-sixth year he was promoted by exception to governor of Guangdong.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was promoted over the usual steps to governor of Guangdong.

units.zh: 入見，奏對稱旨，賜帑金千，及內廝鞍馬。
units.en: At his audience his answers pleased the emperor, who gave him a thousand taels and an imperial saddle horse from the palace stables.
units.literal: On entering audience his replies pleased the emperor, who bestowed a thousand taels of treasury silver and an imperial saddle and horse from the inner stables.

units.zh: 過庾嶺，察知夫役苦累，首禁革之。
units.en: Crossing the Dayu Mountains he saw how porters were abused and was the first to ban the practice.
units.literal: Crossing the Dayu Range he learned how corvée porters suffered and was the first to forbid and abolish the abuse.

units.zh: 复牒兵部，凡使者過境，有驛站供億，不得更有所役。
units.en: He also notified the Ministry of War that travelers must be supplied by courier stations and could not demand extra labor.
units.literal: He also sent a dispatch to the Ministry of War: envoys passing through must rely on courier stations for supply and must not impose further labor.

units.zh: 廣東軍興後，無藝之徵，浮於正供，悉罷免。
units.en: After the wars in Guangdong, irregular levies had exceeded regular taxes; he abolished them all.
units.literal: After military campaigns in Guangdong, levies without statutory basis exceeded regular taxes; he abolished them all.

units.zh: 劾墨吏尤者數人，餘悉奉法。
units.en: He impeached several of the worst corrupt clerks, and the rest fell into line.
units.literal: He impeached the worst corrupt clerks, several men, and the rest all obeyed the law.

units.zh: 鹽法為籓下奸民所亂，據引地莫敢譙訶。
units.en: The salt trade was corrupted by men under the princely establishment who controlled the salt grounds and brooked no challenge.
units.literal: The salt monopoly was thrown into disorder by ruffians under the feudatory; they held the franchise areas and none dared challenge them.

units.zh: 弘祚疏陳整飭鹽政數事，如議行。
units.en: Hongzuo proposed several reforms of the salt administration, and they were adopted.
units.literal: Hongzuo memorialized several measures to rectify salt administration, and they were carried out as proposed.

units.zh: 高州屬縣吳川，瓊州屬縣臨高、澄邁，戶少田蕪，積逋十二萬兩有奇，疏請豁免。
units.en: Wuchuan in Gaozhou and Lin'gao and Chengmai in Qiongzhou, thinly populated and untilled, owed more than 120,000 taels in back taxes; he asked that they be remitted.
units.literal: Wuchuan in Gaozhou prefecture and Lin'gao and Chengmai in Qiongzhou—counties with few households and abandoned fields—had accumulated arrears of more than 120,000 taels; he memorialized asking exemption.

units.zh: 衛所屯田歲輸糧三斗，額重多逃亡。
units.en: Military colony land paid three dou of grain per mu each year; the burden was heavy and many colonists fled.
units.literal: Military colonies paid three dou of grain per year per mu; the quota was heavy and many fled.

units.zh: 弘祚言：「民糧重，則每畝八升八合起科，今屯田浮三之二，非卹兵之道，當比例裁減。」
units.en: Hongzuo wrote: 'Civilian land is taxed at eight sheng eight he per mu at most; colony land is two-thirds higher, which is no way to support the troops and should be cut proportionally.'
units.literal: Hongzuo said: 'For civilian grain, when the burden is heavy, taxation starts at eight sheng eight he per mu; now colony land exceeds that by two-thirds—this is not the way to care for soldiers and should be reduced proportionally.'

units.zh: 事皆允行。
units.en: All were approved.
units.literal: All matters were approved.

units.zh: 逆亂方定，奸民告訐無已，疏請嚴妄首株連之例，略謂：「當定南分鎮，聞風投冒倚藉聲勢者，實繁有徒，迨經平定，籓下人應歸旗者，悉已簿錄解京；
units.en: With the rebellion newly suppressed, informers were endless; he asked strict enforcement against false accusation and guilt by association: 'During the Pacification of the South many pretended ties to the princes; after order was restored those who should return to the banners were registered and sent to Beijing;
units.literal: Rebellion had just been pacified and malicious men lodged endless accusations; he memorialized asking to enforce strictly the precedent on false accusers and implicated parties, briefly saying: 'When the Pacification of the South was garrisoned, many who heard the wind falsely claimed connection and borrowed influence; they were indeed numerous. After pacification, those under the feudatory who should return to the banners were all registered and sent to the capital;

units.zh: 籍內無名者，釋放為民。
units.en: those not on the registers were to be released as civilians.
units.literal: those not named in the registers were released as civilians.

units.zh: 嗣有旨：'籓下官兵、奴僕及貿易人等，除實係遼東舊人及價買人外，逐一清查，發出為民。
units.en: An edict followed: 'Soldiers, servants, and traders of the princely establishments, except true Liaodong subjects or purchased persons, are to be examined and released as civilians.'
units.literal: Later there was an edict: 'Feudatory soldiers, servants, and traders—except those who were genuinely old subjects from Liaodong or were purchased persons—are to be examined one by one and released as civilians.'

units.zh: '臣尋繹詔意，原以諸人皆朝廷赤子，不忍株累。
units.en: I read the edict to mean that these people are all the emperor's subjects and should not be swept up in mass guilt.
units.literal: Your servant further interpreted the edict's intent: originally because all were the court's children, one could not bear to implicate them.

units.zh: 且十餘年來，或補伍，或歸農，或死亡遷徙，無籍可稽。
units.en: In more than ten years many had joined the army, returned to farming, died, or moved away, with no records left.
units.literal: Moreover, over more than ten years some joined the ranks, some returned to farming, some died or moved away, with no register to check.

units.zh: 乃姦宄之徒，蔓引株連，或在部呈首，或向有司告訐；
units.en: Yet scoundrels still dragged others in, accusing them at the ministries or before local officials;
units.literal: Yet villainous persons extended implication and connection, either presenting accusations at the ministries or informing before local officials;

units.zh: 及事白省釋，而官民之被累已深。
units.en: and even when the case was dismissed, victims had already suffered greatly.
units.literal: when the matter was cleared and they were released, officials and people had already suffered deep harm.

units.zh: 請敕部嚴議。」
units.en: He asked the ministries to deliberate and enforce strict rules.'
units.literal: He asked that the ministries be ordered to deliberate strictly.'

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The emperor agreed.
units.literal: The court assented.

units.zh: 三十一年，擢福建浙江總督。
units.en: In the thirty-first year he was made governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
units.literal: In the thirty-first year he was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

units.zh: 值大計，弘祚疏言「福建地瘠民佻」，上責弘祚失言，謂：「賢才不擇地而生。
units.en: At the grand evaluation Hongzuo wrote that 'Fujian has poor soil and frivolous people'; the emperor rebuked him, saying, 'Talent is not born only in favored places.
units.literal: At the grand evaluation Hongzuo memorialized that 'Fujian's land is poor and its people are frivolous'; the emperor rebuked Hongzuo for improper speech, saying: 'Talented men are not choosy about where they are born.

units.zh: 四川巡撫張德地署延綏巡撫，言'延綏邊地，無可舉博學鴻詞者'；
units.en: Zhang Dedi of Sichuan, while acting governor of Yan-sui, said, 'On the Yan-sui frontier no one is fit for the special erudite examination';
units.literal: Governor of Sichuan Zhang Dedi, while acting as governor of Yan-sui, said 'Yan-sui is a border region with no one fit to recommend for the special erudite examination';

units.zh: 少詹事邵遠平奏'南方人輕浮不可用'。
units.en: Vice Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent Shao Yuanping wrote that 'southerners are flighty and unfit for office.'
units.literal: Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent Shao Yuanping memorialized that 'southerners are frivolous and cannot be used.'

units.zh: 朕心甚不愜，因皆罷斥。
units.en: The emperor was deeply displeased and dismissed them all.
units.literal: The imperial mind was greatly displeased, and all were dismissed.

units.zh: 今弘祚又以謬言陳奏，下部議降調。」
units.en: Now Hongzuo had done the same, and the ministries were ordered to consider demoting him.'
units.literal: Now Hongzuo again submitted with erroneous words; the ministries were ordered to deliberate demotion and transfer.'

units.zh: 三十九年，命修高家堰河工，病卒。
units.en: In the thirty-ninth year he was assigned to repair the Gaojia Embankment and died of illness on the job.
units.literal: In the thirty-ninth year he was ordered to repair the Gaojia Embankment river works and died of illness.

units.zh: 子絳，官至廣東布政使；
units.en: His son Jiang became provincial administration commissioner of Guangdong;
units.literal: His son Jiang rose to provincial administration commissioner of Guangdong;

units.zh: 綱，初授兵部主事，累官湖南布政使，雍正間，擢雲南巡撫，疏劾署巡撫楊名時徇隱廢弛，籓庫借支未清款項至十九萬有奇，名時坐是得罪。
units.en: Gang, first a principal clerk in the Ministry of War, rose to provincial administration commissioner of Hunan; under Yongzheng he became governor of Yunnan and impeached acting governor Yang Mingshi for covering up malfeasance and leaving more than 190,000 taels unpaid from the princely treasury; Mingshi was punished.
units.literal: Gang, first appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of War, rose repeatedly to provincial administration commissioner of Hunan; in the Yongzheng reign he was promoted to governor of Yunnan and memorialized that acting governor Yang Mingshi had covered up abuses and neglected duty, and that unpaid advances from the princely treasury amounted to more than 190,000 taels; Mingshi was punished on this account.

units.zh: 尋調撫福建，卒，諡勤恪。
units.en: He was soon transferred to Fujian, died in office, and received the posthumous title Qinke.
units.literal: Soon transferred to govern Fujian, he died; posthumous title Qinke.

units.zh: 王騭，字辰岳，山東福山人。
units.en: Wang Zhi, whose courtesy name was Chenyue, came from Fushan in Shandong.
units.literal: Wang Zhi, courtesy name Chenyue, was a native of Fushan in Shandong.

units.zh: 順治十二年進士，授戶部主事。
units.en: He earned his jinshi in the twelfth year of Shunzhi and became a principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.
units.literal: In the twelfth year of Shunzhi he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.

units.zh: 康熙五年，典試廣東。
units.en: In the fifth year of Kangxi he was chief examiner in Guangdong.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Kangxi he served as chief examiner in Guangdong.

units.zh: 歷刑部郎中。
units.en: He served as director in the Ministry of Justice.
units.literal: He served as director in the Ministry of Justice.

units.zh: 十九年，出為四川松威道。
units.en: In the nineteenth year he became administration commissioner of the Songwei circuit in Sichuan.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year he went out as administration commissioner of the Songwei circuit in Sichuan.

units.zh: 時徵雲南，騭督運軍糧，覆舟墜馬，屢經險阻，師賴以濟。
units.en: During the conquest of Yunnan he supervised army grain transport, survived capsized boats and falls from horses, and kept the army supplied.
units.literal: At the time Yunnan was being conquered; Zhi supervised transport of army grain, capsized boats and fell from horses, passed repeated dangers, and the army relied on him to succeed.

units.zh: 二十四年，壘溪大定堡山後生番出掠，巡撫韓世琦檄兵追剿，令騭駐茂州，與總兵高鼎議剿撫。
units.en: In the twenty-fourth year new tribes behind Dading Fort in Leixi raided; Governor Han Shiqi sent troops in pursuit and stationed Zhi at Maozhou to plan with Regional Commander Gao Ding.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the newly submitted tribes behind Dading Fort in Leixi raided; Governor Han Shiqi dispatched troops to pursue them and ordered Zhi to station at Maozhou to consult with Regional Commander Gao Ding on suppression and pacification.

units.zh: 騭赴堡開諭，番族據巴豬寨，陽就撫，負嵎如故。
units.en: Zhi went to the fort to announce the edict; the tribes held Bazhu Stockade and pretended to submit while remaining defiant.
units.literal: Zhi went to the fort to proclaim the edict; the tribes held Bazhu Stockade, outwardly accepting pacification but still defiant as before.

units.zh: 騭招撫附近諸​​寨，遣兵自廟山進，圍寨，斬獲無算。
units.en: He won over neighboring stockades, sent troops in from Miaoshan, surrounded the stronghold, and killed or captured countless enemies.
units.literal: Zhi won over nearby stockades, sent troops in from Miaoshan, surrounded the stockade, and killed and captured without number.

units.zh: 追至黑水江，賊渠挖子被焚死，山後番眾悉降。
units.en: Pursuing them to the Blackwater River, the chieftain Wazi was burned to death and the mountain tribes all surrendered.
units.literal: Pursuing to the Blackwater River, the bandit chieftain Wazi was burned to death and all the tribes behind the mountains submitted.

units.zh: 調直隸口北道，未行。
units.en: He was transferred to the Koubei circuit in Zhili but had not yet left.
units.literal: He was transferred to the Koubei circuit in Zhili but had not yet departed.

units.zh: 時以太和殿工，命採蜀中柟木。
units.en: Work on the Hall of Supreme Harmony required nanmu timber from Sichuan.
units.literal: At the time, because of work on the Hall of Supreme Harmony, an order was issued to gather nanmu timber in Shu.

units.zh: 騭入覲，疏言：「四川大半環山巉岩，惟成都稍平衍。
units.en: At his audience Zhi wrote: 'Most of Sichuan is ringed by cliffs; only the Chengdu plain is relatively flat.
units.literal: Zhi came to audience and memorialized: 'More than half of Sichuan is ringed by steep cliffs; only Chengdu is somewhat level.

units.zh: 巨材所生，必於深林窮壑，人跡罕到，斧斤難施，所以久存。
units.en: Great trees grow only in deep forests and remote gorges where men seldom go and axes can hardly reach them.
units.literal: Great timbers grow only in deep forests and remote ravines where human tracks rarely reach and axes are hard to apply—therefore they long endure.

units.zh: 民夫入山採木，足胝履穿，攀藤側立，施工既難；
units.en: Laborers who enter the mountains wear out their feet and shoes, cling to vines on sheer slopes, and find the work brutal;
units.literal: When common laborers enter the mountains to cut timber, their feet grow calloused and their shoes wear through; clinging to vines they stand sideways—construction is already difficult;

units.zh: 而運路自山抵江，或百餘裡，或七八十里，深澗急灘，溪流紆折，經時歷月，始至其地。
units.en: the haul from mountain to river may be a hundred li or more over gorges and rapids and can take months.
units.literal: yet the transport route from the mountains to the river may be more than a hundred li or seven or eighty li, with deep gorges and swift rapids and winding streams, taking months before they reach the place.

units.zh: 木在溪間，必待暴水而出，故陸運必於春冬，水運必於夏秋，非可一徑而行，計日而至，其艱如此。
units.en: Logs must wait for floods to float downstream, so hauls go by land in winter and spring and by water in summer and autumn; the hardship is extreme.
units.literal: Timber in the stream must wait for floodwater to float out; thus land transport must be in spring and winter, water transport in summer and autumn—not a single path, not counting days to arrive; the hardship is thus.

units.zh: 且四川禍變相踵，荒煙百里。
units.en: Sichuan has suffered disaster after disaster; for a hundred li one sees only wasteland.
units.literal: Moreover Sichuan has suffered calamities in succession; for a hundred li there is only desolate smoke.

units.zh: 臣當年運糧行間，滿目瘡痍。
units.en: When I transported grain for the army I saw nothing but ruin.
units.literal: When your servant transported grain among the ranks, the eye met only wounds and scars.

units.zh: 自蕩平以後，休養生息。
units.en: Since pacification the province has been recovering.
units.literal: Since pacification, the people have been allowed to rest and grow.

units.zh: 然計通省戶口，仍不過一萬八千餘丁，不及他省一縣之眾。
units.en: Yet the whole province has barely eighteen thousand registered households—fewer than one county elsewhere.
units.literal: Yet the whole province's registered households still number only a little more than eighteen thousand ding—not as many as a single county elsewhere.

units.zh: 就中抽撥五千入山採木，衣糧器具，盈千累百，遣發民夫，遠至千里，近亦數百里，耕作全廢，國賦何徵？
units.en: Drafting five thousand men for logging, with supplies for thousands, and sending laborers hundreds or thousands of li away, ends farming entirely—how can taxes be collected?
units.literal: Of these, drafting five thousand to cut timber, with clothing, grain, and tools in thousands upon hundreds, and sending laborers as far as a thousand li or as near as several hundred, farming is wholly abandoned—how is state tax to be levied?

units.zh: 請敕下撫臣，親詣採柟處察勘，量材取用，其必不能採運者，奏請上裁。」
units.en: He asked that the governor inspect the cutting sites in person, take only what could be moved, and memorialize on what could not.'
units.literal: He asked that the governor be ordered to go in person to the nanmu-cutting sites to inspect, measure materials for use, and for those that truly cannot be cut and transported, memorialize for the emperor's decision.'

units.zh: 疏入，上諭曰：「四川屢經兵火，困苦已極，採木累民。
units.en: When the memorial arrived the emperor said, 'Sichuan has been ravaged by war; logging only adds to the people's misery.
units.literal: When the memorial entered, the emperor instructed: 'Sichuan has repeatedly suffered warfare; distress is extreme, and timber-cutting burdens the people.

units.zh: 塞外松木，取充殿材，足支數百年，何必柟木？
units.en: Pine from beyond the passes can supply the hall for centuries—why insist on nanmu?
units.literal: Pine from beyond the passes can serve as hall timber and suffice for several hundred years—why must it be nanmu?

units.zh: 令免採運。」
units.en: He ordered the logging stopped.'
units.literal: An order was issued to exempt cutting and transport.'

units.zh: 未幾，吏部循例疏請司道內擢京堂，騭未與，特命內升。
units.en: Soon the Ministry of Personnel listed circuit officials for promotion to the capital; Zhi was omitted but was specially promoted.
units.literal: Before long the Ministry of Personnel, following precedent, memorialized asking which circuit intendants should be promoted within the capital to court posts; Zhi was not included, but he was specially ordered promoted within.

units.zh: 尋授光祿寺少卿，累遷太常寺卿。
units.en: He became vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and rose to minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and rose repeatedly to minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

units.zh: 二十六年，授江西巡撫。
units.en: In the twenty-sixth year he was appointed governor of Jiangxi.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was appointed governor of Jiangxi.

units.zh: 陛辭，上諭曰：「大吏以操守為耍，大法則小廉，百姓蒙福。」
units.en: At his farewell the emperor said, 'For high officials integrity is everything; uphold the great principles and small honesty follows, and the people prosper.'
units.literal: At his farewell audience the emperor instructed: 'For great officials integrity is essential; uphold the great law and petty honesty follows, and the people are blessed.'

units.zh: 騭對曰：「臣向在四川，不取民間粒米束草，日費取給於家。」
units.en: Zhi answered, 'In Sichuan I took not a grain or straw from the people and paid my daily costs from my own household.'
units.literal: Zhi replied: 'Your servant, while in Sichuan, took not a grain or bundle of straw from the people; daily expenses were supplied from home.'

units.zh: 上曰：「身為大臣，日費必取給於家，勢有所不能。
units.en: The emperor said, 'A great minister cannot live entirely on his salary—that is understood.
units.literal: The emperor said: 'As a great minister, daily expenses must be supplied from home—there are things one cannot do otherwise.

units.zh: 但操守廉潔，念念愛民，便為良吏，且亦須安靜。
units.en: But stay honest, love the people in your heart, keep order, and you will be a good official.
units.literal: But be incorrupt in integrity, constantly mindful of loving the people, and you will be a good official; you must also keep the realm quiet.

units.zh: 貪污屬吏，先當訓誡；
units.en: Corrupt subordinates should first be warned;
units.literal: Corrupt subordinate officials should first be admonished;

units.zh: 不悛，則糾劾。」
units.en: if they do not reform, impeach them.'
units.literal: if they do not reform, then impeach them.'

units.zh: 瀕行，賜帑金千。
units.en: Before he left, the emperor gave him a thousand taels.
units.literal: As he was about to depart, a thousand taels of treasury silver were bestowed.

units.zh: 二十七年，擢閩浙總督。
units.en: In the twenty-seventh year he became governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

units.zh: 疏言：「江西自蕩平後，積年蠲免銀米二百萬有奇，民生漸裕。
units.en: He reported: 'Since pacification Jiangxi has been granted more than two million taels and piculs in remissions, and livelihood is improving.
units.literal: He memorialized: 'Since Jiangxi was pacified, remissions of silver and grain over the years have totaled more than two million; the people's livelihood has gradually become ample.

units.zh: 然徵收之弊，尚為民累，錢糧明加火​​耗，暗加重戥，部院司道府皆有解費。
units.en: Yet collection abuses remain: open meltage fees, secret overweighting of scales, and delivery fees at every level.
units.literal: Yet abuses in collection still burden the people: grain tax openly adds meltage fees and secretly adds weight to the scales; ministries, provinces, circuits, and prefectures all have delivery fees.

units.zh: 臣入境之初，火耗已減，解費尚存，即揭示剔除積弊，盡革官役上下大小雜費。
units.en: When I arrived meltage had been cut but delivery fees remained; I posted notices abolishing every accumulated abuse and miscellaneous fee.
units.literal: At the start of your servant's entry, meltage had already been reduced but delivery fees remained; proclamations were posted to eliminate accumulated abuses and abolish all large and small miscellaneous fees above and below among officials and clerks.

units.zh: 南昌、新建二縣漕糧尚仍民兌，俱行革除，漕運積年陋規，搜剔無遺。
units.en: Nanchang and Xinjian still collected grain tax in kind from the people; I abolished that and every old abuse in transport.
units.literal: Nanchang and Xinjian counties still had grain tax collected by the people in kind; all were abolished, and long-standing abuses in grain transport were searched out and eliminated without remainder.

units.zh: 但在民則省費，在官則失利。
units.en: The people paid less; officials lost their cut.
units.literal: For the people expenses were saved; for officials profits were lost.

units.zh: 恐臣去後，空言無用，乞天語嚴禁，不致前弊復生。」
units.en: Fearing these reforms would lapse after I left, he asked the emperor to forbid their revival.'
units.literal: Fearing that after your servant's departure empty words would be useless, he begged an imperial command strictly forbidding, so that former abuses would not revive.'

units.zh: 下所司知之。
units.en: The order was sent to the relevant offices.
units.literal: This was sent down to the responsible offices for their knowledge.

units.zh: 時湖廣叛卒夏逢龍據武昌，陷黃州。
units.en: The mutineer Xia Fenglong held Wuchang and seized Huangzhou.
units.literal: At the time the mutinous soldier Xia Fenglong held Wuchang and seized Huangzhou.

units.zh: 騭次邵武，聞警，恐蔓及江西，奏撥福建兵協剿。
units.en: Stopping at Shaowu, Zhi heard the news, feared it would spread to Jiangxi, and asked to send Fujian troops.
units.literal: Zhi stopped at Shaowu, heard the alarm, feared it would spread to Jiangxi, and memorialized to detach Fujian troops for joint suppression.

units.zh: 自海禁既弛，奸民雜入商販，出洋劫掠。
units.en: After the maritime ban was lifted, ruffians mingled with merchants and raided at sea.
units.literal: Since the maritime prohibition was relaxed, evil men mixed into merchants and went overseas to plunder.

units.zh: 騭既上官，即檄溫州總兵蔣懋勳、黃岩總兵林本植、定海總兵董大本以舟師出洋搜捕。
units.en: As soon as Zhi took office, he sent orders to Jiang Maoxun, regional commander of Wenzhou; Lin Benzhi, regional commander of Huangyan; and Dong Daben, regional commander of Dinghai, to take naval forces out to sea and search for the pirates.
units.literal: Once Zhi took office he immediately dispatched Wenzhou Regional Commander Jiang Maoxun, Huangyan Regional Commander Lin Benzhi, and Dinghai Regional Commander Dong Daben with naval forces to search the seas.

units.zh: 懋勳、本植得賊舟七、大本於白沙灣獲巨艦一，斬盜渠楊仕玉等十六輩，釋被擄難民百十一人。
units.en: Maoxun and Benzhi took seven ships; Daben at Baisha Bay seized a great junk, executed sixteen pirate leaders including Yang Shiyu, and freed 111 captives.
units.literal: Maoxun and Benzhi took seven pirate ships; Daben at Baisha Bay seized one great vessel, beheaded sixteen pirate chiefs including Yang Shiyu, and released 111 people who had been captured.

units.zh: 二十八年，上幸浙江，賜騭御用冠服。
units.en: In the twenty-eighth year, when the emperor visited Zhejiang, he gave Zhi imperial court robes.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year the emperor visited Zhejiang and bestowed on Zhi imperial robes for court.

units.zh: 諭曰：「爾任總督，實心任事，浙、閩黎庶稱爾清廉，故特加優賚。」
units.en: He said, 'You have served faithfully; the people of Zhejiang and Fujian praise your integrity, and I reward you accordingly.'
units.literal: He instructed: 'You serve as governor-general with sincere devotion to duty; the people of Zhe and Min call you incorrupt, and therefore special favor is granted.'

units.zh: 未幾，召拜戶部尚書，以老病累疏乞休，詔輒慰留。
units.en: Soon he was made minister of Revenue; old and ill, he repeatedly asked to retire but the emperor always refused.
units.literal: Before long he was summoned and appointed minister of Revenue; because of old age and illness he repeatedly memorialized begging retirement, but edicts always comforted him and kept him at post.

units.zh: 三十三年，召大學士、九卿及河督於成龍入對，上責成龍排陷靳輔，並及騭與左都御史董訥、內閣學士李應薦附和成龍，騭等具疏引罪，訥、應薦並奪官，騭原品休致。
units.en: In the thirty-third year the emperor summoned Yu Chenglong and rebuked him for attacking Jin Fu, implicating Zhi, Dong Ne, and Li Yingjian for siding with him; all confessed; Ne and Yingjian lost their posts and Zhi retired at his former rank.
units.literal: In the thirty-third year the emperor summoned Grand Secretary, the Nine Ministers, and River Director Yu Chenglong for audience, rebuked Chenglong for framing Jin Fu, and extended this to Zhi together with left censor-in-chief Dong Ne and Grand Secretariat academician Li Yingjian for siding with Chenglong; Zhi and the others all submitted memorials admitting guilt; Ne and Yingjian were both stripped of office, and Zhi was allowed to retire at his original rank.

units.zh: 三十四年，卒於家，賜祭葬。
units.en: He died at home in the thirty-fourth year and was granted state burial rites.
units.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he died at home; sacrificial burial was bestowed.

units.zh: 宋犖，字牧仲，河南商丘人，權子。
units.en: Song Luo, whose courtesy name was Muzhong, came from Shangqiu in Henan and was the son of Quan.
units.literal: Song Luo, courtesy name Muzhong, was a native of Shangqiu in Henan and son of Quan.

units.zh: 順治四年，犖年十四，應詔以大臣子列侍衛。
units.en: In the fourth year of Shunzhi, at fourteen, he was selected as a minister's son and placed among the imperial guards.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi, Luo was fourteen; by imperial selection as a minister's son he was ranked among the bodyguards.

units.zh: 逾歲，試授通判。
units.en: A year later he passed an examination and was appointed assistant prefect.
units.literal: After a year, by examination he was appointed assistant prefect.

units.zh: 康熙三年，授湖廣黃州通判。
units.en: In the third year of Kangxi he became assistant prefect of Huangzhou in Huguang.
units.literal: In the third year of Kangxi he was appointed assistant prefect of Huangzhou in Huguang.

units.zh: 以母憂去。
units.en: He left office to mourn his mother.
units.literal: He left office on account of mourning for his mother.

units.zh: 十六年，授理籓院院判，遷刑部員外郎，榷贛關，還遷郎中。
units.en: In the sixteenth year he became vice director of the Court of Colonial Affairs, then vice director in the Ministry of Justice; he supervised the Jiangxi customs post and returned as a director.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year he was appointed vice director of the Court of Colonial Affairs, promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Justice, supervised the Jiangxi customs barrier, and on return was promoted to director.

units.zh: 二十二年，授直隸通永道。
units.en: In the twenty-second year he became administration commissioner of the Tongyong circuit in Zhili.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year he was appointed administration commissioner of the Tongyong circuit in Zhili.

units.zh: 二十六年，遷山東按察使。
units.en: In the twenty-sixth year he was made provincial judge of Shandong.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was promoted to provincial judge of Shandong.

units.zh: 再遷江蘇布政使，察司庫虧三十六萬有奇，犖揭報督撫，責前布政使劉鼎、章欽文分償。
units.en: Promoted to provincial administration commissioner of Jiangsu, he found the treasury short more than 360,000 taels, reported it to the governor-general and governor, and made former commissioners Liu Ding and Zhang Qinwen repay their shares.
units.literal: He was again promoted to provincial administration commissioner of Jiangsu, investigated the treasury and found a deficit of more than 360,000 taels; Luo exposed it to the governor-general and governor and held the former commissioners Liu Ding and Zhang Qinwen responsible to repay in shares.

units.zh: 戶部採銅鑄錢，定值斤六分五釐，犖以江蘇不產銅，採自他省，值昂過半，牒巡撫田雯，疏請停採。
units.en: The Ministry of Revenue bought copper for coinage at six fen five li per jin; Luo argued Jiangsu had no copper and imports cost far more, and asked Governor Tian Wen to memorialize to halt collection.
units.literal: The Ministry of Revenue collected copper to cast coin, fixing the price at six fen five li per jin; Luo said Jiangsu does not produce copper and what is gathered comes from other provinces at more than half again the cost, and sent a dispatch to Governor Tian Wen memorializing to stop collection.

units.zh: 下部議，改視各關例，斤一錢。
units.en: The ministries revised the rate to one qian per jin, following customs-barrier precedent.
units.literal: Sent to the ministries for deliberation, it was changed to follow the precedent of each barrier: one qian per jin.

units.zh: 二十七年，擢江西巡撫。
units.en: In the twenty-seventh year he was made governor of Jiangxi.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was promoted to governor of Jiangxi.

units.zh: 湖廣叛卒夏逢龍為亂，徵江西兵赴剿，次九江，挾餉缺幾譁變。
units.en: When the mutineer Xia Fenglong rose in Huguang, Jiangxi troops marched to suppress him, halted at Jiujiang, and nearly mutinied over missing pay.
units.literal: The mutinous soldier Xia Fenglong of Huguang rebelled; Jiangxi troops were levied to suppress him and halted at Jiujiang; short of pay they nearly mutinied.

units.zh: 犖行次彭澤，聞報，檄發湖口庫帑充行糧，兵乃進。
units.en: Passing Pengze, Luo heard the news, ordered grain money released from the Hukou treasury, and the troops moved on.
units.literal: Luo was traveling and reached Pengze; hearing the report, he dispatched orders to release treasury funds at Hukou for marching grain, and the army advanced.

units.zh: 至南昌受事，舊裁督標兵李美玉、袁大相糾三千餘人，謀劫倉庫，應逢龍以叛。
units.en: At Nanchang he learned that dismissed governor's troops Li Meiyu and Yuan Daxiang had rallied more than three thousand men to loot the warehouses and join Fenglong.
units.literal: On reaching Nanchang to take office, the old dismissed troops of the governor's standard, Li Meiyu and Yuan Daxiang, gathered more than three thousand men and plotted to raid the warehouses and join Fenglong in rebellion.

units.zh: 犖诇知之，捕得美玉、大相，眾恟恟。
units.en: He learned of the plot, arrested Meiyu and Daxiang, and the mob grew restless.
units.literal: Luo learned of it by investigation, arrested Meiyu and Daxiang, and the crowd was in uproar.

units.zh: 犖令即斬以徇，諭眾受煽惑者皆貸不問，眾乃定。
units.en: He had them executed at once and announced that anyone merely led astray would be forgiven; the crowd calmed.
units.literal: Luo ordered them immediately beheaded as a warning; he proclaimed that all who had been incited would be pardoned without question, and the crowd then settled.

units.zh: 江西採竹木，饒州供紫竹，南康、九江供檀、柟諸木，通省派供貓竹，名雖官捐，實為民累，犖疏請動支正帑採買。
units.en: Jiangxi's timber levies fell on the people; Luo asked that purple bamboo, sandalwood, nanmu, and mao bamboo be bought with official funds instead.
units.literal: Jiangxi gathered bamboo and timber: Raozhou supplied purple bamboo, Nankang and Jiujiang supplied sandalwood, nanmu, and other woods; the whole province was assigned mao bamboo—though called official contribution it was in fact a burden on the people; Luo memorialized asking to use regular treasury funds to purchase them.

units.zh: 上命歲終巡撫視察布政司庫，犖疏請糧驛道庫，布政使察覈；
units.en: The emperor ordered yearly inspection of provincial treasuries; Luo proposed that grain-transport and courier funds be audited by the provincial administration commissioner,
units.literal: The emperor ordered that at year's end the governor inspect the provincial treasurer's vault; Luo memorialized that grain-transport and courier treasuries should be inspected by the provincial administration commissioner;

units.zh: 府庫，道員察覈。
units.en: and prefectural treasuries by circuit intendants.
units.literal: prefectural treasuries by circuit intendants.

units.zh: 漢軍文武官吏受代，家屬例當還旗，經過州縣，點驗取結。
units.en: When banner officials finished their terms, their families had to return to the banners and were inspected at every stop.
units.literal: When Manchu civil and military officials of the Eight Banners finished their terms, their families by precedent returned to the banners; passing through prefectures and counties they were checked and certificates taken.

units.zh: 犖曰：「是以罪人待之也。」
units.en: Luo said, 'This treats them like criminals.'
units.literal: Luo said: 'This treats them like criminals.'

units.zh: 疏請自贓私斥革並侵挪帑項解部比追外，止給到京定限咨文，俾示區別。
units.en: He asked that except for corruption cases, returning officials receive only a travel pass with a deadline, not criminal treatment.
units.literal: He memorialized asking that apart from dismissal for corruption and embezzlement of treasury funds sent to the ministries for recovery, only a document with a fixed deadline for reaching the capital should be given, to show the distinction.

units.zh: 皆下部議行。
units.en: The ministries approved and implemented his proposals.
units.literal: All were sent to the ministries for deliberation and carried out.

units.zh: 三十一年，調江蘇巡撫。
units.en: In the thirty-first year he was transferred to governor of Jiangsu.
units.literal: In the thirty-first year he was transferred to governor of Jiangsu.

units.zh: 蘇州濱海各縣遇颶，上元、六合諸縣發山水，淮、揚、徐屬縣河溢，疏請視被災輕重，蠲減如例。
units.en: Suzhou's coast was hit by typhoons, mountain floods struck several counties, and rivers overflowed in Huai-Yang; he asked tax relief scaled to each disaster.
units.literal: Coastal counties of Suzhou met hurricanes; Shangyuan, Liuhe, and other counties sent mountain floods; Huai, Yang, and Xu prefectures and subordinate counties had rivers overflow; he memorialized asking remission according to precedent according to the severity of disaster.

units.zh: 發江寧、鳳陽倉儲米麥散賑。
units.en: He opened granaries in Jiangning and Fengyang for relief grain.
units.literal: He released grain and wheat from Jiangning and Fengyang granaries for relief distribution.

units.zh: 別疏請除太湖傍坍地賦額，戶部以地逾千畝，令詳察。
units.en: He also asked to drop taxes on land swallowed by Tai Lake; the Ministry of Revenue delayed because the area exceeded a thousand mu.
units.literal: In a separate memorial he asked to remove the tax quota on collapsed land beside Tai Lake; the Ministry of Revenue, because the land exceeded a thousand mu, ordered detailed investigation.

units.zh: 犖再疏上陳，上特允之。
units.en: Luo memorialized again and the emperor granted it.
units.literal: Luo memorialized again stating the case; the emperor specially approved.

units.zh: 犖在江蘇，三遇上南巡，嘉犖居官安靜，迭蒙賞賚，以犖年逾七十，書「福」、「壽」字以賜。
units.en: During three imperial tours of the south the emperor praised Luo's steady governance, rewarded him repeatedly, and at over seventy wrote the characters "Fortune" and "Longevity" for him.
units.literal: While Luo was in Jiangsu the emperor made three southern tours, praised Luo for quiet conduct in office, and repeatedly bestowed rewards; because Luo was over seventy, the emperor wrote the characters "Fortune" and "Longevity" and bestowed them.

units.zh: 四十四年，擢吏部尚書。
units.en: In the forty-fourth year he became minister of Personnel.
units.literal: In the forty-fourth year he was promoted to minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 四十七年，以老乞罷，瀕行，賜以詩。
units.en: In the forty-seventh year he retired; the emperor gave him a parting poem.
units.literal: In the forty-seventh year, because of age he begged to retire; as he was about to depart, a poem was bestowed.

units.zh: 五十三年，詣京師祝聖壽，加太子少師，复賜以詩，還裡。
units.en: In the fifty-third year he came to court for the emperor's birthday, was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, received another poem, and went home.
units.literal: In the fifty-third year he went to the capital to congratulate the emperor on his birthday, was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, and again received a poem, then returned home.

units.zh: 卒，年八十，賜祭葬。
units.en: He died at eighty and was granted state burial rites.
units.literal: He died at eighty; sacrificial burial was bestowed.

units.zh: 陳詵，字叔大，浙江海寧人。
units.en: Chen Shen, whose courtesy name was Shuda, came from Haining in Zhejiang.
units.literal: Chen Shen, courtesy name Shuda, was a native of Haining in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 康熙十一年舉人，授中書科中書舍人。
units.en: In the eleventh year of Kangxi he passed the provincial examination and became a drafter in the Secretariat.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Kangxi he passed the provincial examination and was appointed drafter in the Secretariat.

units.zh: 二十八年，考授吏科給事中，乞養歸。
units.en: In the twenty-eighth year he was appointed supervising secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel and retired to care for his parents.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, on examination he was appointed supervising secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel and begged to return home to care for his parents.

units.zh: 三十六年，起補原官。
units.en: In the thirty-sixth year he was recalled to his former post.
units.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was recalled to fill his former post.

units.zh: 輔刑科掌印給事中。
units.en: He served as acting chief supervising secretary with seal in the Office of Scrutiny for Justice.
units.literal: He assisted as chief supervising secretary with seal in the Office of Scrutiny for Justice.

units.zh: 疏言：「淮、黃自古不兩行。
units.en: He wrote: 'The Huai and the Yellow Rivers were never meant to run as one.
units.literal: He memorialized: 'The Huai and the Yellow have from antiquity not run together.

units.zh: 邇者修歸仁堤，開胡家溝，出睢湖之水；
units.en: Recently the Guiren dike was repaired and the Hujia Ditch opened to drain Sui Lake;
units.literal: Recently the Guiren embankment was repaired and the Hujia Ditch opened to release the waters of Sui Lake;

units.zh: 閉六壩，加築高家堰，出洪澤湖之水。
units.en: the six sluices were closed and the Gaojia Embankment raised to drive Hongze Lake water out.
units.literal: the six sluices were closed and the Gaojia Embankment heightened to release the waters of Hongze Lake.

units.zh: 此借淮敵黃不易之理。
units.en: This uses the unchanging principle of turning the Huai against the Yellow.
units.literal: This borrows the unchanging principle of pitting the Huai against the Yellow.

units.zh: 然淮水入運者多，則敵黃仍弱。
units.en: But when too much Huai water enters the canal, the Huai still cannot master the Yellow.
units.literal: Yet when much Huai water enters the Grand Canal, the force against the Yellow is still weak.

units.zh: 舊設天妃閘，自淮、黃交會處至清江浦，凡為五閘，重運到時，更迭啟閉，過即下板鎖斷，是以全淮注黃。
units.en: The old Tianfei sluices from the Huai–Yellow confluence to Qingjiangpu had five gates that opened only for grain transport and then shut, sending the Huai into the Yellow.
units.literal: Formerly the Tianfei Sluices were set up; from where the Huai and Yellow meet to Qingjiangpu there were five sluices in all; when transport grain arrived they opened and closed in rotation, and once past the boards were lowered and locked, so all the Huai was poured into the Yellow.

units.zh: 其引入運河者，不過暫資濟運。
units.en: Only a portion was diverted into the canal to help transport.
units.literal: What was led into the Grand Canal was only to assist transport temporarily.

units.zh: 自改建草壩，淮、黃盡趨運河，清江浦民居可危。
units.en: Since reed sluices were built, the Huai and Yellow rivers have both poured into the canal, endangering Qingjiangpu.
units.literal: Since grass sluices were rebuilt, Huai and Yellow waters all rush into the Grand Canal and the homes of Qingjiangpu are in peril.

units.zh: 宜复天妃閘舊制，使淮易敵黃，有裨大工。」
units.en: The Tianfei system should be restored so the Huai can hold its own against the Yellow and the great works benefit.'
units.literal: The old Tianfei sluice system should be restored so the Huai may more easily contend with the Yellow, benefiting the great works.'

units.zh: 疏下河督張鵬翮議行。
units.en: The memorial was referred to River Director Zhang Penghe for action.
units.literal: The memorial was sent down to River Director Zhang Penghe for deliberation and implementation.

units.zh: 尋疏劾山東蒲台知縣俞宏聲以赦前細故，拘系監生王觀成，迫令自殺；
units.en: He impeached Yu Hongsheng, magistrate of Putai in Shandong, who before an amnesty jailed the student Wang Guancheng over a trifle and drove him to suicide;
units.literal: Soon he memorialized impeaching Yu Hongsheng, magistrate of Putai in Shandong, who for a petty matter before an amnesty had imprisoned the student Wang Guancheng and forced him to suicide;

units.zh: 巡撫王國昌僅以杖責解役結案，玩視民命。
units.en: Governor Wang Guochang merely had a runner beaten and closed the case, showing contempt for life.
units.literal: Governor Wang Guochang only punished with the bamboo and closed the case through a runner, treating the people's lives lightly.

units.zh: 命侍郎吳涵偕詵往按，宏聲坐奪官，國昌等議處。
units.en: The emperor sent Vice Minister Wu Han with Shen to investigate; Hongsheng lost his post and Guochang was punished.
units.literal: The emperor ordered Vice Minister Wu Han to go with Shen to investigate; Hongsheng was stripped of office and Guochang and others were dealt with by law.

units.zh: 授鴻臚寺卿，再遷左副都御史。
units.en: He became minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and then left vice censor-in-chief.
units.literal: He was appointed minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and was again promoted to left vice censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 四十三年，授貴州巡撫。
units.en: In the forty-third year he was appointed governor of Guizhou.
units.literal: In the forty-third year he was appointed governor of Guizhou.

units.zh: 疏言：「貴州田地俱在層岡峻嶺間，土性寒涼，收成歉薄，人牛種蓺維艱。
units.en: He wrote: 'Guizhou fields lie on steep slopes in cold soil with poor yields; farming is desperately hard.
units.literal: He memorialized: 'Guizhou fields are all among layered ridges and steep peaks; the soil is cold and yields are thin; men and oxen find planting hard.

units.zh: 前撫臣王蓺因合屬田地荒蕪十之四五，減輕舊則，招徠開墾成熟，六年後起科。
units.en: Former Governor Wang Yi, finding forty or fifty percent of land abandoned, cut old tax rates and allowed six years before taxing reclaimed fields.
units.literal: Former Governor Wang Yi, because four or five tenths of the province's fields were wasteland, reduced the old rates, encouraged cultivation until maturity, and taxation began after six years.

units.zh: 有續報者亦如之。」
units.en: Later reports were treated the same way.'
units.literal: Where later reports came in, the same rule applied.'

units.zh: 疏下部，如所請。
units.en: The ministries approved as he asked.
units.literal: The memorial was sent to the ministries; as requested.

units.zh: 四十七年，調湖北。
units.en: In the forty-seventh year he was transferred to Hubei.
units.literal: In the forty-seventh year he was transferred to Hubei.

units.zh: 疏劾布政使王毓賢虧帑，命解任。
units.en: He impeached Provincial Administration Commissioner Wang Yuxian for treasury deficits and had him removed.
units.literal: He memorialized impeaching Provincial Administration Commissioner Wang Yuxian for treasury deficits and ordered him dismissed.

units.zh: 尋以盤驗已完，奏免其罪。
units.en: When the audit showed the debt cleared, he asked that Wang be spared further punishment.
units.literal: Soon, because the audit was complete, he memorialized to waive his punishment.

units.zh: 五十年，擢工部尚書。
units.en: In the fiftieth year he became minister of Works.
units.literal: In the fiftieth year he was promoted to minister of Works.

units.zh: 五十二年，調禮部。
units.en: In the fifty-second year he was transferred to the Ministry of Rites.
units.literal: In the fifty-second year he was transferred to the Ministry of Rites.

units.zh: 五十八年，乞休，命致仕。
units.en: In the fifty-eighth year he retired with honors.
units.literal: In the fifty-eighth year he begged to retire and was ordered to leave office with honors.

units.zh: 六十一年，卒，賜祭葬，諡清恪。
units.en: He died in the sixty-first year, was granted state burial, and received the posthumous title Qingke.
units.literal: In the sixty-first year he died; sacrificial burial was bestowed and posthumous title Qingke.

units.zh: 子世倌，自有傳。
units.en: His son Shiguan has his own biography.
units.literal: His son Shiguan has a separate biography.

units.zh: 論曰：當三籓亂時，雲、貴、閩、粵，其發難地也；
units.en: The commentator says: When the Three Feudatories rebelled, Yunnan, Guizhou, Fujian, and Guangdong were where the trouble began;
units.literal: The commentator says: When the Three Feudatories rebelled, Yunnan, Guizhou, Fujian, and Guangdong were where trouble began;

units.zh: 蹂躪所及，湖南北、江西、四川，受害最甚。
units.en: Hunan, Hubei, Jiangxi, and Sichuan suffered most where the armies passed.
units.literal: where their ravages extended, Hunan, Hubei, Jiangxi, and Sichuan suffered most.

units.zh: 伊闢、王繼文撫雲南，從師而南，參與軍畫，其事已別見；
units.en: Yi Pi and Wang Jiwen pacified Yunnan and campaigned south—their stories are told elsewhere;
units.literal: Yi Pi and Wang Jiwen pacified Yunnan, followed the army south, and took part in military planning—their affairs are treated elsewhere;

units.zh: 雍建於貴州，締虞於四川，弘祚於廣東，騭於江西，犖承騭，詵遙繼雍建，兵後撫綏甚勤。
units.en: Yongjian in Guizhou, Diyu in Sichuan, Hongzuo in Guangdong, Zhi in Jiangxi, Luo following Zhi, and Shen distantly continuing Yongjian—all labored hard to restore order after the war.
units.literal: Yongjian in Guizhou, Diyu in Sichuan, Hongzuo in Guangdong, Zhi in Jiangxi, Luo following Zhi, and Shen distantly continuing Yongjian—all toiled diligently to pacify and comfort after the armies.

units.zh: 大亂方定，起衰救弊，出水火，登袵席，偉哉諸人之功歟！
units.en: When great disorder had barely ended, they lifted the ruined realm from fire and water back to safety—what magnificent service these men rendered!
units.literal: Great disorder had just been settled; to raise what was failing, save the people from fire and water, and set them on the mat and cover—how great are these men's achievements!
